narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in extreme southeastern Pennsylvania during the late afternoon and early evening of June 25. Rainfall totals were as high as 1.5 to 3.0 inches.
ev: Moderate flooding occurred along Pennypack Creek in Northeast Philadelphia.
lsr: The Pennypack Creek gauge in Philadelphia reached minor flood stage in just 23 minutes. It eventually crested in moderate flood stage at 9.66 feet at 450 PM.
